checks: A real 36-car, six-police world reaches every member of a four-player binary room without the legacy JSON kick
A host startup failure reaches guests with the original stage and persists through menu teardown without leaking relay credentials
A guest startup failure removes only that driver and gives the host a specific player-left reason
An intentional host exit and an unexpected channel close produce different retained reasons
A heartbeat timeout is reported as a timeout on both ends instead of an intentional host exit
A synchronous data-channel send failure includes packet size and reaches the affected guest without ending other drivers
A synchronous PeerJS error event during send is counted as failure and retains its concrete size reason
Old JSON clients and incompatible metadata receive an update reason before a bounded rejection cleanup
Fresh connection attempts clear old errors, while an obsolete startup catch cannot replace a completed departure reason
Packet limits count UTF-8 bytes, and oversized nonessential frames drop without disconnecting a healthy room
A peer that cannot receive the departure reason is forcibly released after the one-second grace period
